# Audio smoke-test fixture

`jfk.wav` is the canonical speech sample from the
[whisper.cpp sample repository](https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/blob/master/samples/jfk.wav).
It is retained unchanged so the ignored import smoke test exercises decoding,
16 kHz mono conversion, and voice activity detection with repeatable speech.
